description: This file defines a Python class 'DB' for managing MySQL database interactions within a Flask application, including connection setup, query execution, and transaction commit.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A class for managing MySQL database connections and executing queries within a Flask app context.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the database configuration within the Flask app and sets up the MySQL connection.

methods.name: cur
methods.description: Returns a new cursor object for executing database queries.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, optionally replacing a placeholder with the table name.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction to the database.
